product: TIMERANGE_NOW() on the Lakewatch query page uses the selected time range
tagline: On the Lakewatch query page, TIMERANGE NOW() now returns the end of the selected time range instead of the current time, so you can test a detection rule's predicates against historical data.
what_it_does: On the Lakewatch query page, TIMERANGE NOW() now returns the end of the selected time range instead of the current time, so you can test a detection rule's predicates against historical data. Beta Lakewatch is in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page.
why_it_matters: If a source's ingestion latency is so variable that no single extend lookback reliably covers it, you can instead scope the rule on ingestion time.
